note: Weights and scale were fixed before any topology was scored. This file is hash-locked: qa1-decision-matrix.json must carry rubric_sha256 equal to the SHA-256 of this file's bytes. Any weight change is a new rubric and requires a new research revision.

scale.0: the topology fails or badly violates the dimension
scale.2: workable with notable cost or open risk
scale.4: directly supported by implementation or measurement
scale.unknown: null score; the cell is excluded from BOTH weighted sums (renormalized), never mapped to zero, an average, or an advantage; the cell must state what evidence is missing

hard_constraints: gateway-only effects: every worker effect passes exactly one policy gateway (S1-004 SAF, SRC-03)
atomic transition+audit: a guarded state transition and its audit event commit in one transaction (ADR-0002, S1-004 SAF1)
single canonical state owner: exactly one writer of canonical state
hard_constraint_rule: any candidate violating a hard constraint is REJECTED regardless of weighted score

dimensions.atomic_transition_audit: atomic transition + audit и canonical-state consistency
dimensions.migration_reversibility: migration reversibility и условия будущего split

verdict_rules.probes: probe A (unsafe split) and probe B (incomplete monolith) must be REJECTED/INCOMPLETE by the evaluator
verdict_rules.pass: winner stable under every sensitivity perturbation, no unknown cells among the two real candidates, all hard constraints preserved by the winner
verdict_rules.pass_with_limits: winner stable but unknown cells present, or minor weight-flip sensitivity at the edges
verdict_rules.fail: a hard constraint is violated by the recommendation, or probes are accepted, or the matrix is incomplete
verdict_rules.cap: if reasonable weight changes flip the winner, the verdict cannot exceed PASS_WITH_LIMITS
